name: TensorPM v1.39.3
body:
# Changelog - v1.39.3

This update fixes the slowdowns and sync stalls some devices showed after updating to 1.39.1.

## 🔄 Synchronization

- The app stays responsive while cloud data is checked. After 1.39.1, every incoming checkpoint
  made the app re-examine all synchronized records, several times a minute, which could freeze
  the window for seconds at a time.
- Records that have not changed since the last check are no longer examined again.
- Changes to your workspaces are uploaded again on devices that are still waiting for your
  personal encryption key. Before, a single personal file that could not be prepared yet held
  back every other change of the device.
- A workspace whose encryption key has not reached this device yet no longer blocks uploads to
  your other workspaces.
- Personal files upload as soon as the key reaches this device (open another signed-in device
  or recover your encryption keys). Until then they stay safely on this device.
- Far fewer repeated entries in the sync log.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Project file paths that were stored in an older, double-encoded format are readable again, in
  the file explorer and in the Distiller.
- Diagrams in chats and artifacts keep their font, curve style and labels consistently after the
  first diagram.

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.39.3
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-27
- **Previous Version**: 1.39.1
- **Type**: Patch Release (1.39.2 was not published)
